limits: Queue/audio/world intervals overlap and cannot be summed as exclusive phases.
Faster/slower rendered frames accumulate different counts of fixed simulation ticks.
RSP fence wait is remaining work after CPU submission, including RDP backpressure and audio servicing; it is not total RSP execution time.
RDP drain after the RSP fence is only residual RDP work; a small value does not imply a free RDP.
DP busy percentages are conditional polling observations, not total hardware utilization.
profiling.method: Fresh native means per rendered frame, inclusive. CPU mode retains normal pipelining. Pipeline mode deliberately serializes remaining RSP/RDP work before HUD. Empty-scissor mode suppresses 3D coverage while retaining geometry commands. Same NTSC/8 MiB/replay/75-second setup. These are not the quiet release FPS runs.

four.scope: Fresh quiet native Ares pair; NTSC, 8 MiB, release LTO, three surfaces, 32 KiB queues, one-second warmup and 75-second fresh-pose sample. Instrumented CPU and serialized pipeline runs are separate.

one.scope: Fresh quiet native Ares pair; NTSC, 8 MiB, release LTO, three surfaces, 32 KiB queues, one-second warmup and 75-second fresh-pose sample. Instrumented CPU and serialized pipeline runs are separate.
